memberships_scope_ck.name: memberships_scope_ck
memberships_scope_ck.value:
("memberships"."role" = 'org_admin' and "memberships"."company_id" is null and "memberships"."legal_entity_id" is null)
       or ("memberships"."role" <> 'org_admin' and (("memberships"."company_id" is null) <> ("memberships"."legal_entity_id" is null)))

invoice_lines_rates_ck.name: invoice_lines_rates_ck
invoice_lines_rates_ck.value:
"invoice_lines"."vat_rate_bp" between 0 and 10000
      and "invoice_lines"."surcharge_rate_bp" between 0 and 10000 and "invoice_lines"."withholding_rate_bp" between 0 and 10000
